description: This file defines the ExternalAPIPlugin interface for external API integrations in SuiteCRM. It specifies methods for support checking, data loading, login validation, and logging off, serving as a contract for implementing classes.

classes.name: ExternalAPIPlugin
classes.description: Interface that specifies methods for external API plugins used within SuiteCRM to handle authentication and data operations.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if a certain authentication method is supported or returns the list of supported methods if no method is specified.

methods.name: loadEAPM
methods.description: Loads data from an EAPM bean into the plugin.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Verifies if the data from the EAPM bean are valid for login.

methods.name: logOff
methods.description: Logs out from the external service.
